description: Read one contact by the id your own system gives it: pass external_id and customer_id, because an external id is only unique within one customer. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

customer_id.description: The customer: its id, as list_customers shows it.

external_id.description: The id your own system gives the contact.

name: get_contact_by_external_id
